editorial.blurb: Warlord is a theatrical Chicago hotspot where live-fire technique elevates every plate, from their celebrated dry-aged burgers to pristine seafood, all served in an intimate medieval-modern setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive 30 minutes before opening on a Monday for better seating chances—they don't take reservations. Sit at the chef's table or directly in front of the live fire grill to watch the technique that makes their food sing.
